items.title: Uniti’s wholesale fiber transport booms, but fiber broadband suffers ARPU decline
items.summary: Kinetic’s ARPU was down 2.6% year over year, and the company expects Kinetic ARPU to also be down in Q3.

items.title: SpaceX shares big plans for global broadband
items.summary: SpaceX already has 10.3 million Starlink broadband subscribers across 164 countries, but it wants to serve "the majority of internet" around the world.

items.title: Zayo confirms Nvidia as its new ‘monster' customer
items.summary: Nvidia wanted to make sure it's putting enough fiber in the ground both for its own use and for the greater good of the AI ecosystem.

items.title: Indosat launches 1 GW AI infra play with $800M Ooredoo backing
items.summary: Nokia and Nvidia are key players in Indosat and Ooredoo's plan to build up to 1 GW of compute capacity via the newly launched Zankore paltform.

items.title: Fiber broadband spurs consumer AI usage, says Recon Analytics
items.summary: People with fiber connections have AI sessions that are 50% more intensive than people with cable connections.

items.title: SK Telecom’s AI data center bet gains traction with 92.5% revenue growth
items.summary: SK Telecom’s AI data center revenue nearly doubled as it chases a 15 GW infrastructure dream.

items.title: Analysts question whether SpaceX’s mobile mission will lift off
items.summary: Wall Street doesn’t appear to be completely buying into the way Elon Musk intends to compete in the mobile phone industry, but who knows? It’s still early days, in some ways.
